exposure: Prior cesarean delivery (none, one, two or more)
Number of prior cesarean deliveries (none, one, two or more)
cohort: 1399 women who underwent medical abortion with mifepristone and misoprostol at 13-28 weeks gestation
finding: While generally safe, mifepristone-misoprostol abortion in women with prior cesarean sections is associated with an increased risk of complications, such as blood loss and placental retention.
mod_finding: Women with a prior cesarean delivery undergoing medical abortion had a shorter procedural duration compared to nulliparous women.
